notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Pia and Kiran.
description:
Activate Pia and Kiran by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Pia and Kiran enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Pia and Kiran trigger, creating two 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pia and Kiran.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the two Thopters, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
